reviews.x: I am giving it 5 stars for value.  It's not exactly the same as NARS Orgasm but very close. It is a bit more orange/less pink as you can see from the picture of the two side by side (NARS is the smaller/more used one). Yes I like NARS a little better but it is also 3x the price.  If price is a consideration, buy this one.

I was surprised by the color of this blush when I opened it. To me it looked a lot more "peachy" and a bit darker in the package than the images in the item description (see photo). However, although I was nervous to apply this to my face, once I did, I was very pleasantly surprised. The color comes off as very natural and not half as glittery is it appears in the package. I believe that this color would flatter any skin tone, and the amount that you receive is generous. The only down-si

As always Aesthertica products amaze me. I adore this blush and it goes on very light. I was a bit hesitant buying it online, I thought it would be bright and just not work for me. Im a fair skin tone, and it leaves me with just a hint of pink cheeks. It's now my go too blush
I was already a huge fan of Aesthetica products  so I was thrilled when I saw they added a blush. The color is gorgeous and doesn't feel heavy.  I'm very happy with the new addition!!
I never thought I would use blush, especially this color but I love it. It gives my cheeks a nice, warm color to finish my look.

I was a little nervous to order blush online, but this arrived in perfect condition. This Aesthetica Climax Blush goes on smooth and stays on well for a long-lasting natural glow. This is a shimmery peachy pink, just a bit more peachy than the picture looked to me. I think my sister will inherit this. However, she will LOVE it. The compact is thin and small, which I love. I also like that this is talc-free, paraben-free, and cruelty-free. Bottom line, a little too peachy for me, but a very nice

Nice color and great dupe for that famous brand. Doesn't have any type of glitter or anything that comes off...very shimmery and very little glittery type shade... when I use it , it seems a light pinkish peach color and I only applied it once and didn't have to reapply at work. It goes on smooth with my kabuki brush but its not too pigmented to the point you really need to be carefully on applying.. apples lightly so you can control the amount of color.

I have purchased another item from this line I loved it and decided to get the blush. I really like it. It's a great color, it's buildable you can have it subtle or very bright. Stays on a long time. The price is so worth it. It's a dupe for high end blush for a fraction of the price with great quality. I recommend it.

Now that I have being introduced to the world of highlighting and conturing I finally gave a  pink blush a try! I never thought of even considering one because I have an olive tone to my skin.  Well now I put it right on my cheek bones and; HELLO CHEEKBONES! It's beautiful and it gives my face a nice shape. I love it!

reviews.t: Not near as pretty as it looks in image
reviews.x: This is acceptable. Not near as pretty as it looks in image. Has a far more "orangey" tone than pink. Takes a lot to build, so can be used. I was just expecting a more flushed pink blush according to product image and model coloring.
I bought this for my wife thinking it was the pink color pictured. It is not. Not even close. It is orange. Not even a peach color. Very unsatisfied as we did not receive what was pictured.
Lovely light reflecting color which would compliment many complections. It looks good alone or as a dusting over bronzer or blush.

reviews.t: Lacked glow you get from a good blush and was more just a flat color
reviews.x: I purchased this product mainly because it was said to be comparable to NARS blush in the color Orgasm. Well I guess you get what you pay for . While the price was attractive that was about all that was. The color was not as pictured and way to peachy orange for my skin tone. Lacked glow you get from a good blush and was more just a flat color. I'm so glad I was able to return it.

This is one of the most beautiful shades of rose/pink/peach. I have really light skin and so many blushes are way too pink or way to peach. This is a great balance and looks great. It applies evenly and goes on smoothly. Really love it and will re-order when I run out.

reviews.t: If you don't like shimmer this is not for you
reviews.x: Is doesn't have enough pigmentation or color, You have to apply it many times in order to have color! It though it was more mate than shimmer, If you don't like shimmer this is not for you.  Not good quality product!
Nice peachy pink color for my light to medium skin tone, love it!

So it's definitely a quality product, made by a good, cruelty free brand. But I'm disappointed with this blush because it's said to be a terrific dupe for you-know-what by you-know-who, but it is *not*--not by a long shot. That other brand's famous blush is pink with a dab of peach and gold. This, on the other hand, is peach with (more than) a dab of plain old orange, like, straight from the Tropicana tree (see pic). Being a fair-cool brunette, I can't wear orange, so my search for a bunny safe

I was able to purchase this at a discount, since I was unfamiliar with the brand I thought it the perfect opportunity to give it a try.  I have sensitive skin and was hesitant, after using it multiple times I've had no issues.  The color leand more towards a coral than pink but not dissatisfied at all.  Last the entire day, good pigmentation and doesn't break me out.

After reading great reviews about I decided to give it a try. I have brown asian skin with with yellow gold undertone. This blush is gorgeous in the packaging. However, the color is very soft, so soft that the shimmer over powers it. I prefer to layer it over a more pigmented shade. I recommend it for fair complexion but not for darker skin.

Honestly, I like this better than the expensive brand I've purchased in the past. Love the color,  and the way it looks on my skin. It has some shimmer, but not so much that you look like you're wearing glitter. Very well done! Definitely would recommend this blush! Will be buying more. Hopefully, they never discontinue this one.

This color is amazing; a perfect peachy pink with just the right amount of highlight shimmer!  My daughter says it is identical to the famous blush with the suggestive name, haha!! I love it, it's long wearing, and it's really well pigmented. Absolutely cannot beat the price either.

This slightly peachy rosy blusher is about as close to a natural flush as I have ever found. Generally I wear makeup for a little boost to my features for a natural look, but not bare. This is a great product!

reviews.t: It's a really pretty color that should go well with a lot of ...
reviews.x: The powder is light and seems to shimmer just a little.  It's a really pretty color that should go well with a lot of skin tones. I am throwing out my old stuff and will just use this from now on.

reviews.t: Weak color payoff and I’m as pale as flour, ...
reviews.x: Weak color payoff and I’m as pale as flour, tried it with primer, tried it with a wet blender, it just doesn’t show up or immediately blends off
The color is more peach than the rosey color shown here.  It is still workable, but I would have preferred the pinker version.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the blush as a good value and a close, affordable dupe for a high-end brand.
Many reviewers find the color flattering and buildable, working well across different skin tones.
Several reviewers note the actual color is more peachy/orange than the pink shown in the product images.
Some reviewers complain about insufficient pigmentation, requiring multiple applications to build color.
A few reviewers mention shimmer or lack of glow as a drawback.
